direction: Stylized medieval countryside: faceted forged plate, warm leather, tailored heraldic cloth, soft ivory fleece and natural animal anatomy.
authoring: Original deterministic Python meshes in Blender 5.2.3 LTS. No downloaded models or textures.
license: Original project artwork; same private fan-project use as the game.
runtime: Shared three.js GLB assets, also shipped inside the Windows Unreal host. Metres; GLB Y up. Existing analytic gameplay collision is independent of render meshes.

assets.name: Knight
assets.locks: Rest skeleton, gauntlet weapon grip, hips at 0.9 m, profile choices and owner/outfit tint. Cape weights retain the mounted pose. Budget includes every mutually exclusive cosmetic.

assets.name: Horse
assets.locks: Rest skeleton and Body-relative saddle reference at world height 1.65 m. Existing six coat choices, owner blanket tint, walk/trot/gallop and tail joints. Four shared materials; no added texture. The separate resting rein loop is replaced by one dynamic held-rein draw while mounted.

assets.name: Sheep
assets.locks: Existing six animated part pivots, seven instanced draws per pasture. One fleece material shared by every part, procedural vertex colours and no new textures.

assets.name: SheepFar
assets.locks: 22% decimation of each near part, identical pivots/material. Entire pasture changes geometry by nearest animal distance: full detail within 16 m, far beyond 20 m, with hysteresis. No extra draws.

validation: python assets/blender/validate_creatures.py; pnpm verify; CREATURES=1 pnpm e2e creatures; pnpm e2e movement construction buildings world3d combat pvp. Studio turnarounds: blender -b -P assets/blender/preview_creatures.py.
